newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas sees week's first deals as market falls.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas sees week's first deals as market falls.

text.p: The IPE natural gas futures contract saw its first trades of the week on Wednesday afternoon as 55 lots traded in two deals, both at lower prices.
July saw a deal for 50 lots at 11.00 pence a therm, down 0.26 pence from Tuesday's settlement price, while five lots in June traded at 11.20 pence, down 0.22 pence a therm.

By the close there were bids and offers posted for all 12 months of the contract, although the offers were only posted shortly before the close. A little earlier there had been bids for most periods but offers only seen sporadically across the forward curve.

The only month to see a tight bid/offer spread by the close was June, with only 0.125 pence a therm separating bids at 11.20 pence and offers at 11.325 pence. June was also the only month apart from next May to see the closing offer price lower than the previous settlement price. The June contract closes on Thursday.
Dealers said the changes on the futures market showed that futures were following the physical market as normal.
